summary: Tested 3 new features for Nevika Cura Healthcare Platform iteration 384: Order Notifications (WhatsApp via MSG91), Family Members (max 5 limit), and Refill Reminders. Backend: 12/12 tests PASSED. Frontend: 9/9 UI tests PASSED.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing 'X/5 members added' counter display - the component FamilyMembers.jsx has it but the page FamilyMembers.js does not show member count

issues: Dark theme with low contrast text (white/25 for secondary text) - acceptable for dark mode but could be improved

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add 'X/5 members added' counter to FamilyMembers.js page header (currently only in FamilyMembers.jsx component)
critical_code_review_comments: Order notifications API correctly triggers WhatsApp for key statuses (confirmed, shipped, delivered, report_ready) and skips for non-critical statuses (packed, in_progress)
Family member 5-limit is enforced in both /api/health-records/family/{user_id} and /api/family/members endpoints
Refill check endpoint returns proper structure with low_stock_count and alerts_sent
WhatsApp templates gracefully handle missing templates by logging and skipping
seed_data_creation: Family members added via API during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features tested and working: 1) Order Notifications - POST /api/order-status-notify triggers WhatsApp for pharmacy_order/lab_order confirmed status, GET /api/order-notifications/{phone} retrieves notifications, POST /api/order-notifications/{phone}/mark-read marks as read. 2) Family Members - POST /api/health-records/family/{user_id} and /api/family/members both enforce 5-member limit, GET endpoints return members list. 3) Refill Reminders - GET /api/medicine-reminders/refill-check returns low_stock_count and alerts_sent. Home page Quick Services (Consult, Pharmacy, Labs, Book) and Quick Links (My Orders, Prescriptions, CuraPay, Profile) all have correct data-testid attributes.

tests: POST /api/family/members - phase4 endpoint works with 5-member limit
Family members list displayed (3 members visible)
